content.short: Gem Wallet is an open-source self-custody wallet with a privacy-focused design and multichain asset support.
content.description: Gem Wallet is an open-source self-custody wallet built for users who want direct control of assets across many blockchains. Its public positioning emphasizes privacy, local key control, no collection of personal wallet data, and a community-driven product model rather than venture-backed custody. The wallet is designed for everyday asset management, transfers, and DeFi access while keeping the codebase transparent and user-auditable. On Mantle, Gem Wallet fits as a software wallet option for users who prefer open-source tooling, multichain coverage, and a straightforward self-custody experience.
